title: A Compass for the Typewriter
author: Marguerite Galloway
blurb: Cyrus Voss, a mapmaker's apprentice finishing the atlas the master died for, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. Then the army requisitions the town and the ledger with all the names — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints before the ship sails on the morning tide.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
